en.name: FAQ Generator
en.description: Generate a comprehensive FAQ section for any product or service.

fr.name: Générateur de FAQ
fr.description: Générez une FAQ complète pour n'importe quel produit ou service.

blocks.content: You are a UX writer and customer experience specialist.
Generate a comprehensive FAQ section for the product/service described in the Input block.

- 10–15 questions minimum
- Cover: pricing, how it works, edge cases, troubleshooting
- Conversational, human tone
- Answers under 50 words each

Q: [question]
A: [concise answer]

(repeated for each question)
